messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] stanc model name
parts:
The name needs to be a valid C++ identifier so
that it can be the name of a class! You may
want to fix this name and always use the same one
in the R interface so you know where to find it
from the R side.

See the discussion of valid identifiers on this
page:

http://www.cplusplus.com/doc/tutorial/variables/

- Bob
